column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3538): the test runs once per configured backend, and the case it asserts is the same webhook name in TWO tenants, which MySQL cannot construct -- it is single-tenant by constraint (engine.DefaultTenantUUID, all zeros), tiers.yaml D1. The mysql arm skips explicitly rather than falling out of the loop, so the absence shows in the report. Same reason as TestSendMessageCanonicalizesAnUppercaseCallContextTenant/mysql above. PostgreSQL and SQL Server RUN it. Measured by NAME on a real report of ./plugin/ ./plugins/... with all three DSNs set: exactly this one.
